<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>하재범 리듬게임</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@400;700;900&family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@300;400;700&display=swap');

*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
body{background:#0d0e14;color:#d8dce8;font-family:'Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;
  overflow:hidden;height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;user-select:none;}
canvas{display:none;}
.screen{display:none;width:100%;height:100vh;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;padding-top:90px;}
.screen.active{display:flex;}

/* ── 공통 배경 장식 ── */
.screen::after{
  content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(76,195,247,.04) 0%,transparent 50%),
    linear-gradient(225deg,rgba(124,106,247,.04) 0%,transparent 50%);
}

/* ══ TOP NAV (DJMAX 스타일 상단 탭 - 어디서든 바로 이동) ══════════ */
#mainNav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;
  height:90px;display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:space-between;
  background:rgba(8,9,14,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}
.nav-logo{
  display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 2.2rem;
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-weight:900;font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:.1em;
  color:#fff;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);white-space:nowrap;
  transition:opacity .15s;
}
.nav-logo:hover{opacity:.75;}
.nav-logo span{color:#4fc3f7;}
.nav-tabs{display:flex;gap:1.2rem;padding:0 1rem;}
.nav-tab{
  position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.7rem;
  padding:0 1.1rem;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:.12em;
  color:#8a8ea8;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s;user-select:none;border-radius:6px;
}
.nav-tab:hover{color:#d8dce8;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);}
.nav-tab.active{color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(79,195,247,.14),transparent);}
.nav-tab.active::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4fc3f7,#7c6af7);box-shadow:0 0 12px #4fc3f7;
}
.nav-tab.exit{color:#e05c7a;}
.nav-tab.exit:hover{background:rgba(224,92,122,.08);}
.nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 1.6rem;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);}



/* 신스웨이브 격자 배경 (타이틀 화면 전용) */
.sw-grid-floor{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:60%;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(124,106,247,.5) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(124,106,247,.5) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:60px 60px;
  transform:perspective(400px) rotateX(65deg);transform-origin:bottom;
  animation:swGridMove 2s linear infinite;opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;
}
@keyframes swGridMove{from{background-position:0 0;}to{background-position:0 60px;}}
.sw-sun{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:16%;width:360px;height:360px;margin-left:-180px;
  border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,#ff7ac6,#7c6af7 60%,transparent 75%);
  filter:blur(2px);opacity:.55;box-shadow:0 0 130px rgba(255,122,198,.35);pointer-events:none;
}
.sw-sun::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 6px,#0a0512 6px 10px);
  -webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle,#000 60%,transparent 62%);
          mask:radial-gradient(circle,#000 60%,transparent 62%);
}
.sw-scan{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.12;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px);
}

/* 배경 스킨 B: 파티클 오브 */
.tbg-orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(6px);animation:tbgFloat 9s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none;}
@keyframes tbgFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) translateX(0);}50%{transform:translateY(-40px) translateX(20px);}}
.tbg-spark{position:absolute;width:3px;height:3px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:tbgTwinkle 3s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none;}
@keyframes tbgTwinkle{0%,100%{opacity:.1;}50%{opacity:1;}}

/* 배경 스킨 C: 이퀄라이저 */
.tbg-eqwrap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:45%;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:0 4%;opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;}
.tbg-eqbar{width:14px;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4fc3f7,#7c6af7);animation:tbgEqPulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes tbgEqPulse{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.3);}50%{transform:scaleY(1);}}
.tbg-eqglow{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:200px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(79,195,247,.12));pointer-events:none;}

/* 배경 스킨 D: 부드러운 파스텔 (네온 X) */
.tbg-soft-blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(60px);animation:tbgSoftDrift ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none;}

/* 배경 스킨 E: 오로라 */
.tbg-aurora-wrap{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;}
.tbg-aurora-band{
  position:absolute; top:-20%; width:26%; height:140%;
  filter:blur(30px); opacity:.7; mix-blend-mode:screen;
  animation:auroraWave ease-in-out infinite;
  transform-origin:top center;
}
@keyframes auroraWave{
  0%,100%{ transform:translateX(0) skewX(-6deg) scaleY(1); }
  50%{ transform:translateX(6%) skewX(6deg) scaleY(1.08); }
}
@keyframes tbgSoftDrift{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1);}50%{transform:translate(26px,-22px) scale(1.06);}}


#titleScreen{
  background:#0d0e14;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  justify-content:center;
}
/* 배경 사선 줄 */
#titleScreen::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(
    -55deg,transparent,transparent 60px,
    rgba(76,195,247,.025) 60px,rgba(76,195,247,.025) 61px
  );
}
.title-wrap{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;
  padding-left:clamp(3rem,8vw,8rem);z-index:1;width:100%;
}
.title-eyebrow{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.45em;
  color:#4fc3f7;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.8rem;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;
}
.title-eyebrow::before{content:'';display:block;width:32px;height:1px;background:#4fc3f7;}
.title-main{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;
  font-size:clamp(3rem,9vw,6.5rem);
  font-weight:900;line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.01em;
  color:#fff;
}
.title-main span{
  display:block;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 30%,#4fc3f7 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
}
.title-main .line2{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c6af7 0%,#4fc3f7 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
}
.title-sub{
  font-size:.85rem;color:#6a6e88;letter-spacing:.18em;
  margin:.9rem 0 2.4rem;font-weight:300;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.title-btns{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.55rem;align-items:flex-start;}

/* ── 버튼 ── */
.btn{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.18em;
  padding:.7rem 2.2rem;border:1px solid #3a3d55;
  background:#13151f;color:#6a6e88;cursor:pointer;
  text-transform:uppercase;transition:all .18s;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;clip-path:polygon(12px 0%,100% 0%,calc(100% - 12px) 100%,0% 100%);
}
.btn::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4fc3f7,#7c6af7);
  transform:translateX(-105%);transition:transform .25s ease;z-index:0;
}
.btn span,.btn{position:relative;z-index:1;}
.btn:hover::before{transform:translateX(0);}
.btn:hover{color:#fff;border-color:#4fc3f7;}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97);}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4fc3f7,#7c6af7);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;}
.btn-primary::before{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);}

/* ══ SELECT ══════════════════════════════════════ */
#selectScreen{
  background:#0d0e14;
  flex-direction:row;align-items:stretch;padding:90px 0 0 0;gap:0;
}
.select-left{
  width:clamp(260px,35vw,440px);
  background:#13151f;border-right:1px solid #2a2d3e;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:2rem 1.8rem;gap:1rem;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.select-left::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4fc3f7,#7c6af7);
}
.select-header{font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:#4fc3f7;text-transform:uppercase;}
.song-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;flex:1;overflow-y:auto;}
.song-list::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px;}
.song-list::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}
.song-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#3a3d55;}
.song-card{
  background:transparent;border:none;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2d3e;
  padding:.9rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;  border-left:3px solid transparent;
}
.song-card:hover{background:#1a1d2b;border-left-color:#6a6e88;}
.song-card.selected{background:#1a1d2b;border-left-color:#4fc3f7;}
.song-card .sname{font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;color:#d8dce8;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:220px;}
.song-card .smeta{color:#6a6e88;font-size:.72rem;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;margin-top:.2rem;letter-spacing:.05em;}
.select-right{
  flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:2.5rem;gap:1.8rem;position:relative;
}
.select-song-title{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,4vw,2.4rem);
  font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.05em;text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#4fc3f7);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
}
.select-song-meta{font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.8rem;color:#6a6e88;letter-spacing:.2em;}
.diff-select{display:flex;gap:.5rem;}
.diff-btn{
  padding:.5rem 1.4rem;border:1px solid #3a3d55;background:transparent;
  color:#6a6e88;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.72rem;
  letter-spacing:.12em;transition:all .15s;clip-path:polygon(8px 0%,100% 0%,calc(100% - 8px) 100%,0% 100%);
}
.diff-btn:hover{border-color:#6a6e88;color:#d8dce8;}
.diff-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4fc3f7,#7c6af7);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;}
.diff-btn.active-easy{background:#5bc98a;color:#111;}
.diff-btn.active-normal{background:#4fc3f7;color:#111;}
.diff-btn.active-hard{background:#e05c7a;color:#fff;}
.select-btns{display:flex;gap:.7rem;}

/* ══ SETTINGS ════════════════════════════════════ */
#settingScreen{
  background:#0d0e14;flex-direction:row;align-items:stretch;padding:90px 0 0 0;gap:0;
}
.setting-sidebar{
  width:220px;background:#13151f;border-right:1px solid #2a2d3e;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:2rem 1.5rem;gap:.3rem;position:relative;
}
.setting-sidebar::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4fc3f7,#7c6af7);
}
.setting-sidebar-title{font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.25em;color:#4a4e66;margin-bottom:1rem;}
.setting-tab{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.1em;
  padding:.6rem .8rem;background:transparent;border:none;color:#6a6e88;
  cursor:pointer;text-align:left;text-transform:uppercase;transition:all .12s;
  border-left:2px solid transparent;
}
.setting-tab:hover{color:#d8dce8;background:#1a1d2b;}
.setting-tab.active{color:#4fc3f7;border-left-color:#4fc3f7;background:#1a1d2b;}
.setting-main{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:2rem 2.5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;}
.setting-main::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px;}
.setting-main::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#3a3d55;}
.setting-group-title{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:#4fc3f7;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:.6rem 0 .4rem;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2d3e;margin-bottom:.2rem;
}
.setting-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;padding:.75rem 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid #2a2d3e;gap:1rem;
}
.setting-row:hover .setting-label{color:#d8dce8;}
.setting-label{flex:1;font-size:.88rem;color:#6a6e88;transition:color .12s;}
.setting-sub{font-size:.7rem;color:#4a4e66;margin-top:.12rem;}
.vol-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;}
.vol-slider{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:150px;height:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4fc3f7 var(--pct,50%),#3a3d55 var(--pct,50%));
  border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;outline:none;
}
.vol-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#4fc3f7;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 0 8px #4fc3f7;
}
.vol-slider::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:#4fc3f7;cursor:pointer;border:none;
}
.vol-val{font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.8rem;width:34px;text-align:right;color:#4fc3f7;}
.toggle-btn{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.68rem;padding:.3rem .8rem;letter-spacing:.1em;
  border:1px solid #3a3d55;background:transparent;color:#4a4e66;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;
}
.toggle-btn.on{border-color:#5bc98a;color:#5bc98a;background:rgba(91,201,138,.08);}

/* ══ KEY CONFIG ══════════════════════════════════ */
#keyScreen{background:#0d0e14;gap:2rem;}
#keyScreen h2{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:.15em;
  color:#4fc3f7;text-transform:uppercase;
  border-bottom:1px solid #2a2d3e;padding-bottom:.7rem;width:min(440px,90vw);
}
.key-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;width:min(440px,90vw);}
.key-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;
  background:#13151f;border:1px solid #2a2d3e;
  padding:.8rem 1.2rem;clip-path:polygon(10px 0%,100% 0%,calc(100% - 10px) 100%,0% 100%);
}
.key-row-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;flex:1;}
.lane-dot{width:3px;height:28px;border-radius:2px;}
.key-row-name{font-size:.88rem;color:#6a6e88;}
.key-btn{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;
  padding:.45rem 1.1rem;border:1px solid #3a3d55;
  background:#1a1d2b;color:#d8dce8;cursor:pointer;
  min-width:58px;text-align:center;transition:all .15s;letter-spacing:.08em;
}
.key-btn:hover{border-color:#4fc3f7;color:#4fc3f7;}
.key-btn.listening{border-color:#4fc3f7;color:#4fc3f7;background:rgba(76,195,247,.1);animation:keyBlink .6s infinite;}
@keyframes keyBlink{0%,100%{opacity:1;}50%{opacity:.3;}}
.key-hint-txt{color:#4a4e66;font-size:.75rem;text-align:center;letter-spacing:.08em;}

/* ══ GAME ════════════════════════════════════════ */
#gameScreen{position:relative;background:#0d0e14;width:100%;height:100vh;padding-top:0;
  overflow:hidden;flex-direction:row;justify-content:center;align-items:stretch;}
#gameCanvas{display:block !important;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;z-index:1;}
#hud{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  padding:.6rem 5rem .6rem 1.2rem;pointer-events:none;z-index:10;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,14,20,.9) 0%,transparent 100%);
  border-bottom:1px solid #2a2d3e;
}
.hud-block{text-align:center;min-width:90px;}
.hud-label{font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.28em;color:#6a6e88;text-transform:uppercase;}
.hud-val{font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:1.45rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1.1;}
.hud-sep{width:1px;height:32px;background:#2a2d3e;}
#comboDisplay{
  position:absolute;top:30%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  pointer-events:none;z-index:10;text-align:center;
}
#comboNum{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:2.8rem;font-weight:900;
  color:#c8a84b;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(200,168,75,.5);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;
}
#comboLabel{font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.35em;color:#6a6e88;}
#judgement{
  position:absolute;top:44%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;
  pointer-events:none;z-index:10;opacity:0;transition:opacity .1s;letter-spacing:.15em;
}
#progressBar{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:#2a2d3e;z-index:20;}
#progressFill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4fc3f7,#7c6af7);width:0%;transition:width .15s;}
#pauseBtn{
  position:absolute;top:.6rem;right:1.2rem;background:transparent;
  border:1px solid #2a2d3e;color:#6a6e88;cursor:pointer;
  padding:.3rem .7rem;font-size:.72rem;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;
  letter-spacing:.1em;z-index:20;transition:all .15s;
;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;}
#pauseBtn:hover{border-color:#4fc3f7;color:#4fc3f7;}

/* ══ COUNTDOWN ═══════════════════════════════════ */
#countdownOverlay{
  display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:rgba(13,14,20,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
  z-index:100;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;
}
#countdownOverlay.visible{display:flex;}
#countdownNum{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:9rem;font-weight:900;
  color:#fff;line-height:1;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 30%,#4fc3f7);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
}
#countdownNum.pop{animation:countPop .9s ease-out forwards;}
#countdownSong{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.75rem;color:#6a6e88;
  letter-spacing:.35em;margin-top:1.2rem;text-transform:uppercase;
}
@keyframes countPop{
  0%{transform:scale(1.6);opacity:0;}35%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}
  80%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}100%{transform:scale(.7);opacity:0;}
}

/* ══ RESULT ══════════════════════════════════════ */
#resultScreen{
  background:#0d0e14;flex-direction:row;align-items:stretch;padding:90px 0 0 0;
}
.result-left{
  width:clamp(240px,32vw,380px);
  background:#13151f;border-right:1px solid #2a2d3e;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:2.5rem;gap:.8rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.result-left::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4fc3f7,#7c6af7);
}
#resultTitle{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.4em;
  color:#6a6e88;text-transform:uppercase;
}
#resultGrade{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:7rem;font-weight:900;line-height:1;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,currentColor,rgba(255,255,255,.6));
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
}
#resultSongName{font-size:.85rem;color:#6a6e88;letter-spacing:.1em;}
.result-right{
  flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;  padding:2.5rem 3rem;gap:0;
}
.result-right-header{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.3em;
  color:#4fc3f7;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2d3e;padding-bottom:.5rem;margin-bottom:.8rem;
}
.result-stats{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;width:100%;max-width:360px;}
.result-row{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  padding:.6rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2d3e;
}
.result-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.stat-label{color:#6a6e88;font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.08em;}
.stat-val{font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;}
.result-btns{display:flex;gap:.6rem;margin-top:1.8rem;}

/* ══ PAUSE ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
#pauseOverlay{
  display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:rgba(13,14,20,.85);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  z-index:50;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:1.2rem;
}
#pauseOverlay.visible{display:flex;}
.pause-title{
  font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:2rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.25em;
  color:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2d3e;padding-bottom:.8rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;
  width:220px;text-align:center;
}





/* ══ SKILL TREE ══════════════════════════════════ */
#skillTreeScreen{background:#0a0b12;align-items:stretch;justify-content:flex-start;padding-top:90px;}
.sk-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:1.2rem 2rem;border-bottom:1px solid #1e2033;}
.sk-title{font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#fff;}
.sk-title span{color:#4fc3f7;}
.sk-legend{display:flex;gap:1.4rem;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#8a8ea8;}
.sk-legend .dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;margin-right:.4rem;vertical-align:-1px;}
.sk-wrap{position:relative;flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:2rem 1rem 4rem;}
.sk-canvas{position:relative;width:750px;height:1420px;margin:0 auto;}
svg.sk-lines{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;pointer-events:none;}
svg.sk-lines line{stroke:#232640;stroke-width:3;}
svg.sk-lines line.lit{stroke:#4fc3f7;}
.sk-hex{
  position:absolute;width:104px;height:92px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  clip-path:polygon(25% 0%,75% 0%,100% 50%,75% 100%,25% 100%,0% 50%);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;
  font-size:.62rem;line-height:1.25;font-weight:600;padding:6px 10px;
  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s;
}
.sk-hex:hover{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.06);}
.sk-hex .icon{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:2px;}
.sk-hex .cost{position:absolute;top:-8px;right:2px;background:#1a1c2e;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  border-radius:999px;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.52rem;padding:2px 6px;color:#d8dce8;}
.sk-hex.owned::before{content:'✓';position:absolute;top:-8px;left:2px;background:#2ecc71;color:#04220f;
  border-radius:50%;width:16px;height:16px;font-size:.6rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:900;}
.sk-hex.root{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#3a3d55,#1a1c2e 75%);border-color:#5a5f80;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;}
.sk-hex.gold{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#ffe27a,#e0a300 75%);border-color:#ffd54f;color:#3a2900;}
.sk-hex.gold.locked{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#6b5a2a,#3a3016 75%);color:#a89a6c;border-color:#5a4d28;filter:grayscale(.4);}
.sk-hex.qol{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#7fd8ff,#1f8fd6 75%);border-color:#4fc3f7;color:#012233;}
.sk-hex.qol.locked{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#33506b,#182634 75%);color:#7ea2c2;border-color:#2c455c;filter:grayscale(.4);}
.sk-hex.dia{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#d9b8ff,#8b5cf6 75%);border-color:#b794f6;color:#29104f;}
.sk-hex.dia.locked{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#4a3a63,#241b36 75%);color:#a893c4;border-color:#3c2e57;filter:grayscale(.4);}
.sk-hex.combo{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#ffcf9e,#e0703a 75%);border-color:#ff9d5c;color:#3a1c05;}
.sk-hex.combo.locked{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#5a4530,#2b1e14 75%);color:#c2a37e;border-color:#5c3f28;filter:grayscale(.4);}

.sk-hex.hitsound{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#7fd8ff,#1f8fd6 75%);border-color:#4fc3f7;color:#012233;}
.sk-hex.hitsound.locked{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#33506b,#182634 75%);color:#7ea2c2;border-color:#2c455c;filter:grayscale(.4);}
.sk-hex.bgskin{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#a6f0c6,#3ea86e 75%);border-color:#5bc98a;color:#042313;}
.sk-hex.bgskin.locked{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#335a45,#182b20 75%);color:#7ec2a0;border-color:#2c5c40;filter:grayscale(.4);}
.sk-hex.noteskin{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#ffc2e6,#e0559f 75%);border-color:#ff8fc7;color:#3a0a24;}
.sk-hex.noteskin.locked{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#5a3349,#2b1620 75%);color:#c27ea8;border-color:#5c2c46;filter:grayscale(.4);}
.sk-toast{
  position:fixed;bottom:36px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);
  background:#13151f;border:1px solid #3a3d55;border-radius:8px;padding:.8rem 1.6rem;
  font-size:.82rem;color:#d8dce8;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:all .25s;z-index:200;
}
.sk-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}
.sk-skinbar{padding:1.4rem 2rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.1rem;}
.sk-skinrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.9rem;flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.2rem;}
.sk-skinrow-label{flex:0 0 auto;width:88px;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#8a8ea8;}
.sk-skincard{flex:0 0 auto;width:96px;padding:.6rem .5rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #2a2d3e;background:#13151f;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
.sk-skincard .icon{font-size:1.3rem;}
.sk-skincard .name{font-size:.62rem;color:#9a9eb8;margin-top:.25rem;line-height:1.3;white-space:normal;}
.sk-skincard.locked{opacity:.4;cursor:pointer;}
.sk-skincard.locked .icon{filter:grayscale(1);}
.sk-skincard.equipped{border-color:#5566ff;background:#1a1c33;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(85,102,255,.35);}
.sk-skincard.equipped .name{color:#a9b0ff;}
.sk-skincard .eqmark{font-size:.6rem;color:#5566ff;margin-top:.15rem;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- 상단 네비게이션 (어느 화면에서든 탭 클릭하면 바로 이동) -->
<div id="mainNav">
  <div class="nav-logo" onclick="showTitle()" style="cursor:pointer;">RHYTHM <span>GAME</span></div>
  <div class="nav-tabs">
    <div class="nav-tab" data-nav="play" onclick="navGo('play')">▶ &nbsp;PLAY</div>
    <div class="nav-tab" data-nav="skilltree" onclick="navGo('skilltree')">⬡ &nbsp;스킬 트리</div>
    <div class="nav-tab" data-nav="skin" onclick="navGo('skin')">🎨 &nbsp;스킨</div>
    <div class="nav-tab" data-nav="settings" onclick="navGo('settings')">⚙ &nbsp;설정</div>
    <div class="nav-tab exit" data-nav="exit" onclick="navGo('exit')">✕ &nbsp;나가기</div>
  </div>
  <div class="nav-right">
    <div id="authLoggedOut" style="display:flex;">
      <button onclick="doLogin()" class="btn" style="padding:.5rem 1.1rem;font-size:.7rem;">🔑 &nbsp;로그인</button>
    </div>
    <div id="authLoggedIn" style="display:none;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;background:#13151f;border:1px solid #2a2d3e;padding:.5rem 1rem;border-radius:6px;">
      <span id="authEmailDisplay" style="color:#8a8ea8;font-size:.7rem;max-width:150px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;"></span>
      <span style="color:#f5c518;font-size:.75rem;">🪙 <span id="goldDisplay">0</span></span>
      <span style="color:#4fc3f7;font-size:.75rem;">💎 <span id="diaDisplay">0</span></span>
      <button onclick="doLogout()" style="background:transparent;border:1px solid #3a3d55;color:#8a8ea8;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;font-size:.65rem;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;letter-spacing:.05em;">로그아웃</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- 계정 로그인 / 회원가입 모달 -->
<div id="authModal" style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);justify-content:center;align-items:center;">
  <div style="background:#0e0e1a;border:1px solid #333;border-radius:12px;padding:2rem;width:min(380px,90vw);">
    <div style="font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:#4fc3f7;margin-bottom:1.2rem;">ACCOUNT LOGIN</div>
    <div id="authError" style="display:none;font-size:.78rem;color:#e05c7a;margin-bottom:1rem;line-height:1.5;"></div>
    <label style="display:block;font-size:.68rem;color:#6a6e88;margin-bottom:.35rem;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;">EMAIL</label>
    <input id="authEmail" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" autocomplete="username" style="width:100%;padding:.6rem .8rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background:#13151f;border:1px solid #2a2d3e;border-radius:6px;color:#d8dce8;font-size:.9rem;box-sizing:border-box;">
    <label style="display:block;font-size:.68rem;color:#6a6e88;margin-bottom:.35rem;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;">PASSWORD</label>
    <input id="authPassword" type="password" placeholder="6자 이상" autocomplete="current-password" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){event.preventDefault();_authSubmit('signin');}" style="width:100%;padding:.6rem .8rem;margin-bottom:1.4rem;background:#13151f;border:1px solid #2a2d3e;border-radius:6px;color:#d8dce8;font-size:.9rem;box-sizing:border-box;">
    <div style="display:flex;gap:.6rem;">
      <button onclick="_authSubmit('signin')" class="btn btn-primary" style="flex:1;font-size:.72rem;padding:.65rem;">로그인</button>
      <button onclick="_authSubmit('signup')" class="btn" style="flex:1;font-size:.72rem;padding:.65rem;">회원가입</button>
    </div>
    <button onclick="closeAuthModal()" style="margin-top:1rem;width:100%;background:transparent;border:1px solid #444;color:#aaa;padding:.6rem;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.68rem;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;">닫기</button>
    <button onclick="if(window._retryFirebaseInit)window._retryFirebaseInit();" style="margin-top:.6rem;width:100%;background:transparent;border:1px solid #2a2d3e;color:#6a6e88;padding:.5rem;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.62rem;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;">🔄 로그인 시스템 다시 불러오기</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- TITLE -->
<div id="titleScreen" class="screen active" style="position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0512 0%,#1a0a2e 45%,#0a0512 100%);">
  <div id="bgDecor"></div>
  <div style="position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1.2rem;">
    <div class="title-eyebrow" style="justify-content:center;">RHYTHM · ACTION</div>
    <div class="title-main" style="text-align:center;">
      <span>RHYTHM</span>
      <span class="line2">GAME</span>
    </div>
    <div class="title-sub">4-LANE RHYTHM ACTION</div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="showSelect()" style="font-size:1.1rem;padding:.9rem 3.2rem;letter-spacing:.3em;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(79,195,247,.45);">▶ &nbsp;PLAY</button>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:1.4rem;margin-top:.6rem;">
      <span onclick="showKeyConfig()" style="cursor:pointer;color:#6a6e88;font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.1em;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;">⌨ 키 설정</span>
      <span onclick="showHowTo()" style="cursor:pointer;color:#6a6e88;font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.1em;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;">❓ 게임 방법</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- SKILL TREE -->
<div id="skillTreeScreen" class="screen">
  <div class="sk-header">
    <div class="sk-title">SKILL <span>TREE</span> <span id="devModeBadge" style="display:none;font-size:.6rem;background:#e05c7a;color:#fff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:.6rem;">🛠 DEV MODE · 재화 무제한</span></div>
    <div class="sk-legend">
      <span><span class="dot" style="background:#e0a300;"></span>🪙 골드</span>
      <span><span class="dot" style="background:#1f8fd6;"></span>🎵 타격음</span>
      <span><span class="dot" style="background:#5bc98a;"></span>🖼 배경 스킨</span>
      <span><span class="dot" style="background:#ff8fc7;"></span>🔷 노트 스킨</span>
      <span><span class="dot" style="background:#8b5cf6;"></span>💎 명예</span>
      <span><span class="dot" style="background:#e0703a;"></span>✨ 콤보 이펙트</span>
    </div>
    <button class="btn" onclick="showTitle()" style="font-size:.65rem;padding:.5rem 1rem;">← BACK</button>
  </div>
  <div class="sk-wrap">
    <div style="text-align:center;font-family:'Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;font-size:.7rem;color:#5a5d78;margin-bottom:.4rem;">가로로 스크롤해서 전체 트리를 볼 수 있어요 →</div>
    <div class="sk-canvas" id="skCanvas">
      <svg class="sk-lines" id="skLines"></svg>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="sk-toast" id="skToast"></div>

<!-- SKIN -->
<div id="skinScreen" class="screen">
  <div class="sk-header">
    <div class="sk-title">SKIN <span>CLOSET</span></div>
    <button class="btn" onclick="showTitle()" style="font-size:.65rem;padding:.5rem 1rem;">← BACK</button>
  </div>
  <div style="padding:1rem 2rem 0;text-align:center;font-family:'Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;font-size:.72rem;color:#5a5d78;">
    보유한 스킨을 클릭해서 바로 장착하세요. 잠긴 스킨은 <span style="color:#8a8ea8;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;" onclick="showSkillTree()">⬡ 스킬 트리</span>에서 언락할 수 있어요.
  </div>
  <div class="sk-skinbar" id="skSkinBar"></div>
</div>

<!-- SETTINGS -->

<div id="settingScreen" class="screen">
  <div class="setting-sidebar">
    <div class="setting-sidebar-title">OPTIONS</div>
    <button class="setting-tab active" id="stab-sound" onclick="switchSettingTab('sound')">SOUND</button>
    <button class="setting-tab" id="stab-game" onclick="switchSettingTab('game')">GAMEPLAY</button>
    <div style="flex:1"></div>
    <button class="btn" onclick="showTitle()">← BACK</button>
  </div>
  <div class="setting-main" id="settingMain">    <!-- filled by JS -->
  </div>
</div>

<!-- KEY CONFIG -->
<div id="keyScreen" class="screen">
  <h2>KEY CONFIG</h2>
  <div class="key-rows" id="keyRows"></div>
  <div class="key-hint-txt">변경할 레인 클릭 후 원하는 키 입력 · ESC = 취소</div>
  <div style="display:flex;gap:.8rem;margin-top:.8rem;">
    <button class="btn" onclick="resetKeys()">↺ DEFAULT</button>
    <button class="btn" onclick="showTitle()">← BACK</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- SELECT -->
<div id="selectScreen" class="screen">
  <div class="select-left">
    <div class="select-header">SELECT TRACK</div>
    <div class="song-list" id="songList"></div>
    <div class="diff-select" id="diffSelect">
      <button class="diff-btn active active-easy" data-diff="easy"   onclick="setDiff(this)">EASY</button>
      <button class="diff-btn"        data-diff="normal" onclick="setDiff(this)">NORMAL</button>
      <button class="diff-btn"        data-diff="hard"   onclick="setDiff(this)">HARD</button>
    </div>
    <div class="select-btns">
      <button class="btn" onclick="showTitle()">← BACK</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="select-right">
    <div style="text-align:center;">
      <div class="select-song-title" id="selectSongTitle">네온 비트</div>
      <div class="select-song-meta" id="selectSongMeta">BPM 128 · POP / DANCE</div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="startGame()" style="font-size:1rem;padding:.9rem 3.5rem;">▶ &nbsp;START</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- GAME -->
<div id="gameScreen" class="screen">
  <div id="progressBar"><div id="progressFill"></div></div>
  <div id="missFlash" style="position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(255,0,0,0);pointer-events:none;z-index:20;transition:background .05s;"></div>
  <div id="hpBar" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:5px;z-index:15;background:#111;"><div id="hpFill" style="height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#44ff88,#4fc3f7);transition:width .15s;"></div></div>
  <canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
  <div id="hud">
    <div class="hud-block"><div class="hud-label">Score</div><div class="hud-val" id="scoreDisplay">0</div></div>
    <div class="hud-sep"></div>
    <div class="hud-block"><div class="hud-label">Time</div><div class="hud-val" id="timeDisplay">0:00</div></div>
    <div class="hud-sep"></div>
    <div class="hud-block"><div class="hud-label">Accuracy</div><div class="hud-val" id="accDisplay">100%</div></div>
    <div class="hud-sep"></div>
    <div class="hud-block"><div class="hud-label">Difficulty</div><div class="hud-val" id="diffDisplay" style="font-size:.9rem">-</div></div>
  </div>
  <div id="comboDisplay"><div id="comboNum">0</div><div id="comboLabel">COMBO</div></div>
  <div id="judgement"></div>
  <button id="pauseBtn" onclick="togglePause()">ESC  ⏸</button>
  <div id="countdownOverlay">
    <div id="countdownNum">3</div>
    <div id="countdownSong"></div>
  </div>
  <div id="pauseOverlay">
    <div class="pause-title">PAUSED</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.8rem;color:#888;margin-bottom:1rem;letter-spacing:.1em;">
      SCORE <span id="pauseScore" style="color:#fff">0</span> &nbsp;|&nbsp;
      COMBO <span id="pauseCombo" style="color:#c8a84b">0</span> &nbsp;|&nbsp;
      ACC <span id="pauseAcc" style="color:#4fc3f7">100%</span>
    </div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="togglePause()">▶ RESUME</button>
    <button class="btn" onclick="quitGame()">✕ QUIT</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- RESULT -->
<div id="resultScreen" class="screen">
  <div class="result-left">
    <div id="resultTitle">CLEAR</div>
    <div id="resultGrade">S</div>
    <div id="resultSongName">네온 비트</div>
  </div>
  <div class="result-right">
    <div class="result-right-header">RESULT DATA</div>
    <div class="result-stats">
      <div class="result-row"><span class="stat-label">SCORE</span><span class="stat-val" id="rScore">0</span></div>
      <div id="newBestBanner" style="display:none;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:#ffe066;text-shadow:0 0 20px #ffe066;margin-top:.3rem;">★ NEW BEST! ★</div>
      <div class="result-row"><span class="stat-label">ACCURACY</span><span class="stat-val" id="rAcc">0%</span></div>
      <div class="result-row"><span class="stat-label">MAX COMBO</span><span class="stat-val" id="rCombo">0</span></div>
      <div class="result-row"><span class="stat-label">PERFECT</span><span class="stat-val" id="rPerfect" style="color:#c8a84b">0</span></div>
      <div class="result-row"><span class="stat-label">GOOD</span><span class="stat-val" id="rGood" style="color:#5bc98a">0</span></div>
      <div class="result-row"><span class="stat-label">MISS</span><span class="stat-val" id="rMiss" style="color:#d94f4f">0</span></div>
    </div>
    <div id="rewardDisplay" style="display:none;font-family:'Orbitron',monospace;font-size:1rem;color:#f5c518;letter-spacing:.2em;margin-bottom:.8rem;text-shadow:0 0 15px #f5c518;"></div>
    <div class="result-btns">
      <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="retrySong()">↺ RETRY</button>
      <button class="btn" onclick="nextSong()">→ NEXT</button>
      <button class="btn" onclick="showTitle()">⌂ TITLE</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// ── Firebase 연동 함수 ──
window._userGold=0; window._userDia=0;
function doLogin(){ openAuthModal(); }
function doLogout(){ if(window._fbSignOut) window._fbSignOut(); }
function openAuthModal(){
  const m=document.getElementById('authModal'); if(!m) return;
  m.style.display='flex';
  document.getElementById('authEmail').value='';
  document.getElementById('authPassword').value='';
  const err=document.getElementById('authError');
  if(err){ err.style.display='none'; err.textContent=''; }
}
function closeAuthModal(){ const m=document.getElementById('authModal'); if(m) m.style.display='none'; }
function updateCurrencyUI(){
  const g=document.getElementById('goldDisplay');
  const d=document.getElementById('diaDisplay');
  const badge=document.getElementById('devModeBadge');
  if(typeof DEV_MODE!=='undefined' && DEV_MODE){
    if(g) g.textContent='∞';
    if(d) d.textContent='∞';
    if(badge) badge.style.display='inline-block';
    return;
  }
  if(badge) badge.style.display='none';
  if(g) g.textContent=(window._userGold||0).toLocaleString();
  if(d) d.textContent=(window._userDia||0).toLocaleString();
}
function awardCurrency(failed, perfect, total){
  const mult=getGoldMultiplier();
  const gold=failed?0:Math.round(100*mult);
  const isPerfect=!failed&&total>0&&perfect===total;
  const dia=isPerfect?10:0;
  window._userGold=(window._userGold||0)+gold;
  window._userDia=(window._userDia||0)+dia;
  updateCurrencyUI();
  // increment()로 서버에 원자적으로 더함 (로컬 절대값 덮어쓰기가 아니라서
  // 로그인 직후 서버값 로딩과 겹쳐도 보상이 씹히지 않음)
  if(window._fbAddCurrency&&window._fbUser)
    window._fbAddCurrency(window._fbUser.uid,gold,dia);
  const el=document.getElementById('rewardDisplay');
  if(el){ el.style.display='block'; el.innerHTML='🪙 +'+gold+(dia>0?' &nbsp;💎 +'+dia:''); }
}

// ══════════════════ 스킬 트리 ══════════════════
// 헥사곤 좌표계 (odd-q offset, flat-top)
const SK_SIZE=56, SK_W=SK_SIZE*2, SK_H=Math.sqrt(3)*SK_SIZE;
const SK_COLSPACE=SK_W*0.75, SK_ROWSPACE=SK_H;
const SK_ORIGIN_X=150, SK_ORIGIN_Y=740;
function skPos(col,row){
  const x=SK_ORIGIN_X+col*SK_COLSPACE;
  const y=SK_ORIGIN_Y+row*SK_ROWSPACE+(col%2!==0?SK_ROWSPACE/2:0);
  return {x,y};
}

  {id:'bg0',col:1,row:-1.4,type:'bgskin',icon:'🌙',label:'소프트\n파스텔 테마',free:true,skin:'soft',requires:'root'},

const SK_EDGES=[
  ['root','g1'],['g1','g2'],['g2','g3'],['g3','g4'],['g4','g5'],
  ['root','h1'],['h1','h2'],['h2','h3'],['h3','h4'],['h4','h5'],
  ['root','bg0'],['bg0','bg1'],['bg1','bg2'],['bg2','bg3'],['bg3','bg4'],
  ['root','n1'],['n1','n2'],['n2','n3'],
  ['root','d1'],['d1','d2'],['d2','d3'],
  ['root','c1'],['c1','c2'],
];
// 스킬 트리 소유 여부 조회 헬퍼
function skHasNode(id){ return skGetOwned().includes(id); }
function hasPitchRandomize(){ return (typeof DEV_MODE!=='undefined'&&DEV_MODE)||skHasNode('h5'); }

// 노드를 습득/장착했을 때 실제 게임에 효과를 적용
function applySkillEffect(node){
  if(node.type==='hitsound' && typeof node.soundIdx==='number'){
    HIT_SOUND_TYPE = node.soundIdx;
    try{ localStorage.setItem('hitSoundType', String(node.soundIdx)); }catch(e){}
    if(typeof initAudio==='function') initAudio();
    if(typeof playHitSound==='function') playHitSound(1,'PERFECT');
  }
  if(node.type==='bgskin' && node.skin && typeof applyTitleBgSkin==='function'){
    applyTitleBgSkin(node.skin);
  }
  if(node.type==='noteskin' && node.skin && typeof applyNoteSkin==='function'){
    applyNoteSkin(node.skin);
  }
}

// ── 타이틀 배경 스킨 (grid=기본 / orb=파티클 오브 / eq=이퀄라이저 / soft=부드러운 파스텔) ──
function applyTitleBgSkin(skinId){
  try{ localStorage.setItem('titleBgSkin', skinId); }catch(e){}
  const deco=document.getElementById('bgDecor');
  const titleEl=document.getElementById('titleScreen');
  if(!deco) return;
  deco.innerHTML='';
  if(titleEl){
    titleEl.style.background = (skinId==='soft')
      ? 'linear-gradient(180deg,#2b2638 0%,#40384f 45%,#2b2638 100%)'
      : 'linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0512 0%,#1a0a2e 45%,#0a0512 100%)';
  }
  if(skinId==='orb'){
    const orbColors=['rgba(79,195,247,.45)','rgba(124,106,247,.45)','rgba(255,122,198,.35)'];
    for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
      const o=document.createElement('div');
      const size=80+Math.random()*160;
      o.className='tbg-orb';
      o.style.width=size+'px'; o.style.height=size+'px';
      o.style.left=(Math.random()*90)+'%'; o.style.top=(10+Math.random()*70)+'%';
      o.style.background='radial-gradient(circle, '+orbColors[i%orbColors.length]+', transparent 70%)';
      o.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*6)+'s';
      o.style.animationDuration=(7+Math.random()*6)+'s';
      deco.appendChild(o);
    }
    for(let i=0;i<50;i++){
      const s=document.createElement('div');
      s.className='tbg-spark';
      s.style.left=(Math.random()*100)+'%'; s.style.top=(Math.random()*100)+'%';
      s.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*3)+'s';
      deco.appendChild(s);
    }
  } else if(skinId==='eq'){
    const glow=document.createElement('div'); glow.className='tbg-eqglow'; deco.appendChild(glow);
    const wrap=document.createElement('div'); wrap.className='tbg-eqwrap';
    for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
      const b=document.createElement('div');
      b.className='tbg-eqbar';
      b.style.height=(40+Math.random()*220)+'px';
      b.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*1.1)+'s';
      b.style.animationDuration=(0.8+Math.random()*0.8)+'s';
      wrap.appendChild(b);
    }
    deco.appendChild(wrap);
  } else if(skinId==='soft'){
    // 네온 느낌 없는 잔잔한 파스텔 구름 - 천천히 부드럽게 떠다니기만 함
    const softColors=['rgba(232,180,188,.4)','rgba(184,169,217,.4)','rgba(143,184,172,.35)','rgba(214,201,169,.3)'];
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
      const o=document.createElement('div');
      const size=280+Math.random()*220;
      o.className='tbg-soft-blob';
      o.style.width=size+'px'; o.style.height=size+'px';
      o.style.left=(Math.random()*80)+'%'; o.style.top=(Math.random()*70)+'%';
      o.style.background='radial-gradient(circle, '+softColors[i%softColors.length]+', transparent 72%)';
      o.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*6)+'s';
      o.style.animationDuration=(16+Math.random()*10)+'s';
      deco.appendChild(o);
    }
  } else if(skinId==='aurora'){
    // 오로라: 물결치는 초록/보라 빛 밴드가 위에서 흘러내리는 느낌
    const wrap=document.createElement('div'); wrap.className='tbg-aurora-wrap';
    const bandColors=['rgba(90,230,180,.35)','rgba(140,110,240,.32)','rgba(80,200,220,.3)'];
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      const b=document.createElement('div');
      b.className='tbg-aurora-band';
      b.style.background='linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, '+bandColors[i]+', transparent)';
      b.style.left=(10+i*28)+'%';
      b.style.animationDelay=(i*2.4)+'s';
      b.style.animationDuration=(9+i*2)+'s';
      wrap.appendChild(b);
    }
    deco.appendChild(wrap);
    for(let i=0;i<60;i++){
      const s=document.createElement('div');
      s.className='tbg-spark';
      s.style.left=(Math.random()*100)+'%'; s.style.top=(Math.random()*60)+'%';
      s.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*3)+'s';
      deco.appendChild(s);
    }
  } else { // 'grid' 기본값: 신스웨이브
    deco.innerHTML='<div class="sw-sun"></div><div class="sw-grid-floor"></div><div class="sw-scan"></div>';
  }
}

// ── 노트 스킨 (default=기본 / diamond=다이아몬드 / ring=네온 링) ──
let NOTE_SKIN = (function(){ try{ return localStorage.getItem('noteSkin')||'default'; }catch(e){ return 'default'; } })();
function applyNoteSkin(skinId){
  NOTE_SKIN=skinId;
  try{ localStorage.setItem('noteSkin', skinId); }catch(e){}
}

function skGetOwned(){
  try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('skillTreeOwned')||'["root","g1","bg0"]'); }
  catch(e){ return ['root','g1','bg0']; }
}
function skSaveOwned(arr){ try{ localStorage.setItem('skillTreeOwned', JSON.stringify(arr)); }catch(e){} }

function getGoldMultiplier(){
  const owned=skGetOwned();
  let best=1.00;
  SKILL_NODES.forEach(n=>{ if(n.type==='gold' && n.mult && owned.includes(n.id)) best=Math.max(best,n.mult); });
  return best;
}

function showSkillTree(){ renderSkillTree(); showScreen('skillTreeScreen'); }
function showSkinScreen(){ renderSkinPanel(); showScreen('skinScreen'); }

function renderSkillTree(){
  const canvas=document.getElementById('skCanvas');
  const svg=document.getElementById('skLines');
  if(!canvas||!svg) return;
  // 기존 헥사곤 노드 제거 (svg는 유지)
  canvas.querySelectorAll('.sk-hex').forEach(el=>el.remove());
  svg.innerHTML='';

  const owned=skGetOwned();
  const byId={};
  SKILL_NODES.forEach(n=>{ const p=skPos(n.col,n.row); byId[n.id]={...n,...p}; });

  SK_EDGES.forEach(([a,b])=>{
    const A=byId[a], B=byId[b];
    const line=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','line');
    line.setAttribute('x1',A.x); line.setAttribute('y1',A.y);
    line.setAttribute('x2',B.x); line.setAttribute('y2',B.y);
    if(owned.includes(a)) line.classList.add('lit');
    svg.appendChild(line);
  });

  Object.values(byId).forEach(n=>{
    const div=document.createElement('div');
    const isOwned=owned.includes(n.id);
    const lockedClass=(n.type!=='root' && !isOwned) ? ' locked':'';
    const ownedClass=isOwned?' owned':'';
    div.className='sk-hex '+n.type+lockedClass+ownedClass;
    div.style.left=n.x+'px'; div.style.top=n.y+'px';
    div.innerHTML=`<div class="icon">${n.icon}</div><div>${n.label.replace('\n','<br>')}</div>`;
    if(n.cost){
      const c=document.createElement('div'); c.className='cost';
      c.textContent=(n.cost.gold?('🪙'+n.cost.gold):'')+(n.cost.dia?('💎'+n.cost.dia):'');
      div.appendChild(c);
    }
    if(n.type!=='root') div.onclick=()=>buySkillNode(n.id);
    canvas.appendChild(div);
  });
}

// ── 스킨함: 배경/노트 스킨 + 타격음을 한눈에 보고 바로 장착할 수 있는 패널 ──
function renderSkinPanel(){
  const bar=document.getElementById('skSkinBar');
  if(!bar) return;
  const owned=skGetOwned();
  const curBg = (function(){ try{ return localStorage.getItem('titleBgSkin')||'soft'; }catch(e){ return 'soft'; } })();
  const curNote = (function(){ try{ return localStorage.getItem('noteSkin')||'default'; }catch(e){ return 'default'; } })();
  const curHit = HIT_SOUND_TYPE;

  function buildRow(label, nodes, isEquipped, onPick){
    const row=document.createElement('div'); row.className='sk-skinrow';
    const lab=document.createElement('div'); lab.className='sk-skinrow-label'; lab.textContent=label;
    row.appendChild(lab);
    nodes.forEach(n=>{
      const isOwned = n.free || owned.includes(n.id);
      const eq = isOwned && isEquipped(n);
      const card=document.createElement('div');
      card.className='sk-skincard'+(isOwned?'':' locked')+(eq?' equipped':'');
      card.innerHTML=`<div class="icon">${n.icon}</div><div class="name">${n.label.replace('\n',' ')}</div>${eq?'<div class="eqmark">✓ 장착중</div>':(isOwned?'':'<div class="eqmark">🔒 미보유</div>')}`;
      card.onclick=()=>{
        if(!isOwned){ skToast('스킬 트리에서 먼저 언락하세요 ("'+n.label.replace('\n',' ')+'")'); return; }
        onPick(n);
      };
      row.appendChild(card);
    });
    return row;
  }

  // 기본값(항상 무료)은 스킬 트리 노드로 존재하지 않아서 직접 카드로 추가해줌
  const NOTE_DEFAULT = {id:'__note_default', icon:'⬜', label:'기본\n노트', skin:'default', free:true};
  const HIT_DEFAULT  = {id:'__hit_default',  icon:'🎹', label:'피아노\n(기본)', soundIdx:0, free:true};

  bar.innerHTML='';  bar.appendChild(buildRow('🖼 배경 스킨',
    SKILL_NODES.filter(n=>n.type==='bgskin'),
    n=>n.skin===curBg,
    n=>{ applyTitleBgSkin(n.skin); renderSkinPanel(); skToast('"'+n.label.replace('\n',' ')+'" 장착!'); }
  ));
  bar.appendChild(buildRow('🔷 노트 스킨',
    [NOTE_DEFAULT, ...SKILL_NODES.filter(n=>n.type==='noteskin')],
    n=>n.skin===curNote,
    n=>{ applyNoteSkin(n.skin); renderSkinPanel(); skToast('"'+n.label.replace('\n',' ')+'" 장착!'); }
  ));
  bar.appendChild(buildRow('🎵 타격음',
    [HIT_DEFAULT, ...SKILL_NODES.filter(n=>n.type==='hitsound' && typeof n.soundIdx==='number')],
    n=>n.soundIdx===curHit,
    n=>{
      HIT_SOUND_TYPE=n.soundIdx;
      try{ localStorage.setItem('hitSoundType', String(n.soundIdx)); }catch(e){}
      if(typeof initAudio==='function') initAudio();
      if(typeof playHitSound==='function') playHitSound(1,'PERFECT');
      renderSkinPanel(); skToast('"'+n.label.replace('\n',' ')+'" 장착!');
    }
  ));
}

function skToast(msg){
  const t=document.getElementById('skToast'); if(!t) return;
  t.textContent=msg; t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(window._skToastTimer);
  window._skToastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'), 2200);
}

function buySkillNode(id){
  const node=SKILL_NODES.find(n=>n.id===id); if(!node) return;
  const owned=skGetOwned();
  const dev = typeof DEV_MODE!=='undefined' && DEV_MODE;
  const EQUIPPABLE_TYPES=['bgskin','noteskin','hitsound'];
  if(owned.includes(id)){
    if(EQUIPPABLE_TYPES.includes(node.type)){
      // 배경/노트/타격음 스킨류만 클릭으로 다시 장착(교체) 가능
      applySkillEffect(node);
      if(typeof renderSkinPanel==='function') renderSkinPanel();
      skToast('"'+node.label.replace('\n',' ')+'" 장착!');
    } else {
      // 골드/다이아/콤보이펙트/판정보조는 영구 적용형 — 항상 보유한 것 중 가장 좋은 단계가 자동 적용됨
      skToast('✔ 이미 적용된 업그레이드예요 (자동으로 최고 단계가 계속 적용돼요)');
    }
    return;
  }
  if(!dev){
    if(node.requires && !owned.includes(node.requires)){ skToast('이전 단계를 먼저 열어주세요'); return; }
    const costGold=node.cost&&node.cost.gold||0;
    const costDia=node.cost&&node.cost.dia||0;
    if((window._userGold||0)<costGold){ skToast('골드가 부족해요 (🪙'+costGold+' 필요)'); return; }
    if((window._userDia||0)<costDia){ skToast('다이아가 부족해요 (💎'+costDia+' 필요)'); return; }
    window._userGold=(window._userGold||0)-costGold;
    window._userDia=(window._userDia||0)-costDia;
    updateCurrencyUI();
    if(window._fbAddCurrency&&window._fbUser)
      window._fbAddCurrency(window._fbUser.uid,-costGold,-costDia);
  }

  owned.push(id); skSaveOwned(owned);
  applySkillEffect(node);
  updateCurrencyUI();
  renderSkillTree();
  if(typeof renderSkinPanel==='function') renderSkinPanel();
  const permMsg = EQUIPPABLE_TYPES.includes(node.type) ? '' : ' (영구 적용됨, 계속 최고 단계로 유지돼요)';
  skToast('✓ "'+node.label.replace('\n',' ')+'" 습득!'+permMsg+(dev?' (DEV MODE)':''));
}


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SETTINGS STATE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
const VOL = { master:0.80, music:0.80, hit:0.70, count:0.70, miss:0.50 };
let NOTE_SPEED = 600;
const TOGGLES  = { showJudge:true, showCombo:true };

function updateVol(key, val) {
  VOL[key] = val/100;
  document.getElementById('val'+key.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+key.slice(1)).textContent = val;
  // update slider gradient
  const sl = document.getElementById('vol'+key.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+key.slice(1));
  if(sl) sl.style.setProperty('--pct', val+'%');
  // live update music gain
  if(key==='master'||key==='music') applyMusicGain();
}
function updateNoteSpeedSetting(val) {
  NOTE_SPEED = parseInt(val) * 10;  // 슬라이더 20~100 → 실제 200~1000 px/s
  document.getElementById('valSpeed').textContent = val;
  const sl = document.getElementById('noteSpeed');
  const pct = ((val-20)/(100-20)*100).toFixed(1);
  sl.style.setProperty('--pct', pct+'%');
}
function toggleSetting(key) {
  TOGGLES[key] = !TOGGLES[key];
  const id = key==='showJudge'?'toggleJudge':'toggleCombo';
  const btn = document.getElementById(id);
  btn.textContent = TOGGLES[key]?'ON':'OFF';
  btn.classList.toggle('on', TOGGLES[key]);
}

//  KEY BINDING
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
const COLORS     = ['#ff3366','#ff9900','#00ccff','#aa44ff'];
const DEFAULT_KEYS = ['a','s','k','l'];
let playerKeys   = [...DEFAULT_KEYS];
function keyToLane(k){ return playerKeys.indexOf(k.toLowerCase()); }

function showKeyConfig(){ buildKeyRows(); showScreen('keyScreen'); }
function resetKeys(){ playerKeys=[...DEFAULT_KEYS]; buildKeyRows(); }

let listeningLane = -1;
function buildKeyRows(){
  const c=document.getElementById('keyRows'); c.innerHTML='';
  const names=['레인 1','레인 2','레인 3','레인 4'];
  playerKeys.forEach((k,i)=>{
    const row=document.createElement('div'); row.className='key-row';
    row.innerHTML=`<div class="key-row-label">
      <div class="lane-dot" style="background:${COLORS[i]}"></div>
      <span class="key-row-name">${names[i]}</span></div>
      <button class="key-btn" id="kbtn${i}" onclick="startListening(${i})">${k.toUpperCase()}</button>`;
    c.appendChild(row);
  });
}
function startListening(lane){
  listeningLane=lane;
  document.querySelectorAll('.key-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('listening'));
  document.getElementById('kbtn'+lane).classList.add('listening');
  document.getElementById('kbtn'+lane).textContent='?';
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  AUDIO ENGINE  (gain-node mixer for live vol control)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
let audioCtx=null, masterGain=null, musicGain=null, hitGain=null, sfxGain=null;
let musicNodes=[];
let currentAudioTimer=null;
let musicRequestId=0; // 오래된 비동기 음악 디코딩 결과를 무효화
let currentAudioSource=null;
let currentAudioGain=null;
let currentAudioBuffer=null;
const decodedCache = {};  // songId → AudioBuffer 캐시

function initAudio(){
  if(audioCtx) return;
  audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  masterGain = audioCtx.createGain(); masterGain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  musicGain  = audioCtx.createGain(); musicGain.connect(masterGain);
  hitGain    = audioCtx.createGain(); hitGain.connect(masterGain);
  sfxGain    = audioCtx.createGain(); sfxGain.connect(masterGain);
  applyMusicGain();
}
function applyMusicGain(){
  if(!masterGain) return;
  masterGain.gain.value = VOL.master;
  if(musicGain) musicGain.gain.value = VOL.music;
  if(currentAudioGain) currentAudioGain.gain.value = Math.min(1, VOL.music * VOL.master);
}

function beep(freq,dur,vol,type,dest){
  if(!audioCtx) return;
  const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(), g=audioCtx.createGain();
  o.connect(g); g.connect(dest||masterGain);
  o.type=type||'sine'; o.frequency.value=freq;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,audioCtx.currentTime);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,audioCtx.currentTime+dur);
  o.start(); o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+dur+.01);
}
// 노트 타격음: 짧고 임팩트 있는 클릭+톤
// ⚠ 개발/테스트 모드: 골드·다이아 무제한, 스킬 트리 전 노드 구매 가능
// 다 됐다 싶으면 false로 바꿔서 끄면 됨 (사용자가 "그만"이라고 할 때까지 켜둠)
const DEV_MODE = true;
let HIT_SOUND_TYPE = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('hitSoundType')||'0',10)||0;
let SYNC_OFFSET = 0;
let NOTE_SIZE_MULT = 1.0;
function updateSync(val){ SYNC_OFFSET=parseInt(val); document.getElementById('valSync').textContent=val+'ms'; }

// ── 싱크 테스트 (박자 맞추기로 오프셋 추천) ──
let syncTestTimer=null, syncTestBeatStart=0, syncTestBpm=100, syncTestTaps=[];
function openSyncTest(){
  initAudio();
  const m=document.getElementById('syncTestModal'); if(!m) return;
  m.style.display='flex';
  restartSyncTest();
}
function closeSyncTest(){
  const m=document.getElementById('syncTestModal'); if(m) m.style.display='none';
  if(syncTestTimer){ clearInterval(syncTestTimer); syncTestTimer=null; }}
function restartSyncTest(){
  syncTestTaps=[];
  updateSyncTestUI();
  if(syncTestTimer) clearInterval(syncTestTimer);
  const interval=60000/syncTestBpm; // 100 BPM = 600ms 간격
  syncTestBeatStart=performance.now();
  const doBeat=()=>{
    syncTestBeatStart=performance.now();
    if(audioCtx) beep(880,0.05,0.35,'sine');
    const p=document.getElementById('syncPulse');
    if(p){ p.style.transform='scale(1.25)'; setTimeout(()=>{ p.style.transform='scale(1)'; },90); }
  };
  doBeat();
  syncTestTimer=setInterval(doBeat, interval);
}
function syncTestTap(){
  if(!syncTestBeatStart) return;
  const interval=60000/syncTestBpm;
  let diff=(performance.now()-syncTestBeatStart);
  // 가장 가까운 박자 기준으로 -interval/2 ~ +interval/2 범위로 보정
  diff = ((diff+interval/2) % interval) - interval/2;
  const p=document.getElementById('syncPulse');
  if(p){ p.style.transform='scale(0.85)'; setTimeout(()=>{ p.style.transform='scale(1)'; },80); }
  // 처음 1번은 워밍업으로 버리고, 최대 8개까지만 기록
  if(syncTestTaps.length===0 && Math.abs(diff)>interval*0.4){ return; } // 너무 어긋난 첫 탭은 무시
  syncTestTaps.push(diff);
  if(syncTestTaps.length>8) syncTestTaps.shift();
  updateSyncTestUI();
}
function updateSyncTestUI(){
  const cnt=document.getElementById('syncTapCount');
  const rec=document.getElementById('syncRecommend');
  const applyBtn=document.getElementById('syncApplyBtn');
  if(cnt) cnt.textContent=Math.min(syncTestTaps.length,8);
  if(syncTestTaps.length>=3){
    const avg=Math.round(syncTestTaps.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/syncTestTaps.length);
    const clamped=Math.max(-200,Math.min(200,avg));
    if(rec) rec.textContent=(clamped>0?'+':'')+clamped+'ms';
    if(applyBtn){ applyBtn.disabled=false; applyBtn.style.opacity='1'; applyBtn.dataset.value=clamped; }
  } else {
    if(rec) rec.textContent='-';
    if(applyBtn){ applyBtn.disabled=true; applyBtn.style.opacity='.4'; }
  }
}
function applySyncTestResult(){
  const applyBtn=document.getElementById('syncApplyBtn');
  if(!applyBtn || applyBtn.disabled) return;
  const val=parseInt(applyBtn.dataset.value||'0',10);
  SYNC_OFFSET=val;
  const so=document.getElementById('syncOffset'); if(so) so.value=val;
  const vs=document.getElementById('valSync'); if(vs) vs.textContent=val+'ms';
  skToast('싱크 오프셋 '+(val>0?'+':'')+val+'ms 적용됨');
  closeSyncTest();
}
function updateNoteSize(val){ NOTE_SIZE_MULT=parseInt(val)/100; document.getElementById('valNoteSize').textContent=val+'%'; }

function playHitSound(lane, type){
  if(!audioCtx) return;
  const v = VOL.hit * VOL.master;
  if(v < 0.001) return;
  const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
  let lf = [440,494,523,587][lane];
  if(typeof hasPitchRandomize==='function' && hasPitchRandomize()){
    lf *= (0.94 + Math.random()*0.12); // ±6% 피치 랜덤화
  }
  switch(HIT_SOUND_TYPE){
    case 0: { // 피아노 (따뜻하고 맑음)
      beep(lf,     0.08, v*0.5, 'sine',     hitGain);
      beep(lf*2,   0.06, v*0.3, 'sine',     hitGain);
      beep(lf*0.5, 0.04, v*0.2, 'triangle', hitGain);
      break; }
    case 1: { // 마림바 (통통 튀는 느낌)
      beep(lf*2,   0.04, v*0.6, 'sine',     hitGain);
      beep(lf*3,   0.03, v*0.3, 'sine',     hitGain);
      beep(lf,     0.06, v*0.2, 'triangle', hitGain);
      break; }
    case 2: { // DJ클릭 (선명하고 드라이)
      beep(lf*1.5, 0.025,v*0.7, 'square',   hitGain);
      beep(lf,     0.04, v*0.4, 'sine',     hitGain);
      if(type==='PERFECT') beep(lf*4,0.02,v*0.2,'sine',hitGain);
      break; }
    case 3: { // 동전 (짤랑짤랑)
      [1200,1500,1800,2100].forEach((f,i)=>
        beep(f, 0.04-i*0.005, v*(0.5-i*0.08), 'sine', hitGain));
      break; }
    case 4: { // 팝 (퐁! 주파수 하강)
      const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(), g=audioCtx.createGain();
      o.connect(g); g.connect(hitGain);
      o.type='sine';
      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(600,now);
      o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(150,now+0.12);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(v*0.8,now);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,now+0.13);
      o.start(now); o.stop(now+0.14);
      break; }
  }
}
function playMissSound(){
  if(!audioCtx) return;
  const v = VOL.miss * VOL.master;
  if(v<0.001) return;
  beep(180, 0.15, v*0.6, 'sawtooth', sfxGain);
  beep(120, 0.12, v*0.4, 'sine', sfxGain);
}
function playCountBeep(n){
  if(!audioCtx) return;
  const v = VOL.count * VOL.master;
  if(v<0.001) return;
  if(n>0) beep(440,0.15,v,'sine');
  else    beep(880,0.35,v,'sine');
}

// ─── Music Scheduling ───────────────────────────
// schedule a single oscillator note on musicGain bus
function schedNote(freq,start,dur,vol,type,vibrato){
  if(!audioCtx) return;
  const o=audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const g=audioCtx.createGain();
  o.type=type||'sine'; o.frequency.value=freq;
  // vibrato
  if(vibrato){
    const lfo=audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const lfoG=audioCtx.createGain();
    lfo.frequency.value=vibrato.rate||5;
    lfoG.gain.value=vibrato.depth||4;
    lfo.connect(lfoG); lfoG.connect(o.frequency);
    lfo.start(start); lfo.stop(start+dur+0.1);
    musicNodes.push(lfo);
  }
  o.connect(g); g.connect(musicGain);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,start);
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol,start+Math.min(0.02,dur*0.1));
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,start+dur-Math.min(0.08,dur*0.3));
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,start+dur);
  o.start(start); o.stop(start+dur+0.05);
  musicNodes.push(o);
}
// noise burst for snare/hi-hat
function schedNoise(start,dur,vol,lpFreq){
  if(!audioCtx) return;
  const buf=audioCtx.createBuffer(1,Math.ceil(audioCtx.sampleRate*dur),audioCtx.sampleRate);
  const d=buf.getChannelData(0);
  for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1);
  const src=audioCtx.createBufferSource();
  const flt=audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  flt.type='bandpass'; flt.frequency.value=lpFreq||2000; flt.Q.value=0.8;
  const g=audioCtx.createGain();
  src.buffer=buf; src.connect(flt); flt.connect(g); g.connect(musicGain);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,start);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,start+dur);
  src.start(start); src.stop(start+dur+0.05);
  musicNodes.push(src);
}

function playDecodedBuffer(decoded, travelMs, songId){
  if(!decoded || !audioCtx) return;
  currentAudioBuffer = decoded;
  const src = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
  src.buffer = decoded;
  const gainNode = audioCtx.createGain();
  const volMap={0:0.8,1:0.9,2:0.85,3:0.9,4:0.85};
  const songVol=volMap[songId]!==undefined?volMap[songId]:1.0;
  const baseGain = Math.min(1, VOL.music * VOL.master * songVol);
  gainNode.gain.value = baseGain;
  src.connect(gainNode); gainNode.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  currentAudioSource = src;
  currentAudioGain = gainNode;
  const startAt = audioCtx.currentTime + Math.max(0.05, travelMs/1000);
  src.start(startAt);
  // whEn_thE_nights (songId=0): 전체 -20%, 구간 추가 -40%
  if(songId === 0){
    const g0 = baseGain * 0.8;   // 평소 (-20%)
    const g1 = baseGain * 0.48;  // 시끄러운 구간 (-20% -40%)
    gainNode.gain.value = g0;
    // 32~58초
    gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(g0, startAt + 31.5);
    gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(g1, startAt + 32.5);
    gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(g1, startAt + 57.5);
    gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(g0, startAt + 58.5);
    // 1분12초(72초)~1분37초(97초)
    gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(g0, startAt + 71.5);
    gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(g1, startAt + 72.5);
    gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(g1, startAt + 96.5);
    gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(g0, startAt + 97.5);
  }
}

function scheduleMusic(songId, travelMs){
  stopMusic();
  const requestId = musicRequestId;
  const gameAtRequest = gameState;
  initAudio();
  const song = SONGS[songId];
  if(!song) return;
  if(song.audioSrc){
    if(decodedCache[songId]){
      // 이미 디코딩된 캐시 사용
      playDecodedBuffer(decodedCache[songId], travelMs, songId);
    } else {      const b64 = song.audioSrc.split(',')[1];
      const bin = atob(b64);
      const buf = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
      for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++) buf[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
      audioCtx.decodeAudioData(buf.buffer.slice(0), (decoded)=>{
        decodedCache[songId] = decoded;
        if(requestId!==musicRequestId || gameState!==gameAtRequest || !gameAtRequest || gameAtRequest.ended) return;
        if(SONGS[selectedSong]!==gameAtRequest.song) return;
        playDecodedBuffer(decoded, travelMs, songId);
      }, (e)=>console.error('decodeAudioData error:', e));
    }
  } else if(song.schedFn){
    const t0 = audioCtx.currentTime + travelMs/1000;
    song.schedFn(t0);
  }
}

// 곡 선택 시 미리 디코딩 (showSelect 후 백그라운드)
function preDecodeAudio(songId){
  initAudio();
  const song = SONGS[songId];
  if(!song||!song.audioSrc||decodedCache[songId]) return;
  const b64 = song.audioSrc.split(',')[1];
  const bin = atob(b64);
  const buf = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++) buf[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
  audioCtx.decodeAudioData(buf.buffer.slice(0), (decoded)=>{
    decodedCache[songId]=decoded;
  }, ()=>{});
}
function stopMusic(){
  musicRequestId++;
  if(currentAudioTimer){ clearTimeout(currentAudioTimer); currentAudioTimer=null; }
  if(currentAudioSource){
    try{ currentAudioSource.stop(); }catch(e){}
    currentAudioSource=null;
  }
  currentAudioGain=null;
  currentAudioBuffer=null;
  musicNodes.forEach(n=>{ try{n.stop();}catch(e){} });
  musicNodes=[];
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  NOTE MAPS — 음악 이벤트에 정확히 싱크 (DJ MAX 스타일)
//  각 악기가 소리나는 타이밍 = 노트 1개, 레인에 분산 배치
//  {t:ms, l:레인(0-3), g:롱노트, h:홀드ms}
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

function normalizeMap(raw){
  // 레인별 롱노트 끝 시간 추적 - 롱노트 구간 내 모든 노트 제거
  const laneEnd = {0:-1,1:-1,2:-1,3:-1};
  const sorted = [...raw].sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t);
  const result = [];
  for(const n of sorted){
    if(n.t < 500) continue; // 시작 0.5초 이전 노트 제거 (즉시 MISS 방지)
    if(n.t < laneEnd[n.l]) continue; // 롱노트 구간 안 → 스킵
    result.push({time:n.t, lane:n.l, isLong:n.g||false, holdMs:n.h||0});
    if(n.g) laneEnd[n.l] = n.t + n.h;
  }
  return result;
}


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  AUDIO FILES (base64 embedded MP3)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
const AUDIO_whEn_thE_nights_come_aftEr_30minutEs = 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,
